Yes — for 30 of the 32 weapons logged as evidence, the register records who the weapon was recovered from, and that person's status on the same case can be read straight off the record.

Worked example:
  - 30 بور پستول, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 891/24; recovered from شہزیب عرف شابی; recorded status on that case: گرفتار، بعد ازاں سزا یافتہ. The criminal-record system additionally records "Convicted, on bail pending appeal" for that person on the same FIR.

The same chain holds for the other traceable weapons — 11 more of the 29 shown here:
  - 30 بور پستول بمعہ 3 گولیاں, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 214/26; recovered from شہزیب عرف شابی; recorded status on that case: گرفتار. The criminal-record system additionally records "Under trial" for that person on the same FIR.
  - 30 بور پستول بمعہ 6 گولیاں, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 1001/26; recovered from کاشف; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.
  - 30 بور پستول بمعہ 6 گولیاں, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 201/26; recovered from فیصل; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.
  - 30 بور پستول بمعہ 6 گولیاں, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 202/26; recovered from طارق; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.
  - 30 بور پستول, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 203/26; recovered from ندیم; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.
  - 30 بور پستول بمعہ 6 گولیاں, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 204/26; recovered from کاشف; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.
  - 30 بور پستول بمعہ 3 گولیاں, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 210/26; recovered from ذیشان; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.
  - 30 بور پستول بمعہ 3 گولیاں, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 212/26; recovered from عمران; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.
  - 30 بور پستول, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 213/26; recovered from کاشف; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.
  - 30 بور پستول, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 217/26; recovered from کاشف; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.
  - 30 بور پستول بمعہ 3 گولیاں, بغیر لائسنس — logged in FIR 218/26; recovered from عدنان; recorded status on that case: زیر تفتیش.

2 of the 32 record no person at all — they are crime-scene recoveries rather than items taken off an accused: عام لکڑی کی چھڑی، ایک عدد (fir-117-26); خالی خول (فائرنگ کا شاہد)، جائے وقوعہ سے برآمد (fir-266-26).

Caveat on how solid this trail is: the weapon -> person link is NOT an enforced database key. The weapon register stores `recovered_from` as a bare name, so it is matched to the accused named in the SAME FIR — i.e. the trail runs weapon -> FIR number -> accused. The criminal-record outcome above is joined the same way, on the FIR number parsed out of a free-text case reference. It holds for this data, but a name repeated across two FIRs would not be distinguished by it.

**3. The overlap between the two.**
  4 of 33 criminal records name an FIR that is also a case in this corpus, so only those can be read on both sides at once:
  - FIR 214-26 (شہزیب عرف شابی) - charged under Arms Ordinance 1965 §13, PPC §302, PPC §34, PPC §392; court stage: "Under trial".
